bio: This genuine Parisian bistro still boasts its period Belle Époque interior (woodwork, copper pots, mirrors, velvet banquettes) and everything down to the plates bears the B monogram, further adding to the authentic vibe. Proudly and heartily traditional, the recipes star country produce: pâté en croûte, calf’s head with ravigote sauce, cassoulet, millefeuille pastry!...
